Commit: c64998ec7083ff1ca52241f1fa0966ddb823650e Channel: beta
fix(app): stabilize settings, desktop overrides, and display policies
Reuse the settings sheet and defer persistence until confirmation so opening and closing settings no longer rebuilds the main interface or writes on every edit. Keep the detail pane within usable bounds.

Retry desktop captures and desktop image installation without falling back to preview artwork, verify new override paths before pruning old files, and persist per-display recovery records across disconnected monitors.

Evaluate fullscreen, coverage, sleep, reveal, stop, resume, and playlist behavior independently for each display.

Commit: b108edba3544c4a308aa4ac2839cab8b7a52bf52 Channel: beta
fix(app): unstick browsing scroll, creator grid, and activation
The Discover rows installed an app-wide scrollWheel monitor on hover that hand-forwarded vertical events: it walked up to the nearest ancestor NSScrollView, called scrollWheel(with:) on it directly, and swallowed the original. That bypasses responsive scrolling, and since phase events carry zero deltas they took the same branch and were consumed too, so gestures lost their begin and end. A gesture that scrolled content out from under the cursor also tore the monitor down mid-flight. Drop the monitor entirely and let AppKit route the event; the arrows only ever needed the horizontal offset, so read that from the clip view's boundsDidChange instead.
The creator grid used adaptive(minimum:) with no maximum, so columns stretched to fill and 140 and 170 rendered identically in the 420pt pane. It also stored its size under ExplorerIconSize, shared with the library grid, which is why adjusting the view there appeared to move only the left side. Give it its own key with widths scaled for the narrow pane, bound the column, and hang the view menu on the scroll view and the empty states so a right-click in the gutter lands.
refreshLoginItemStatus assigned loginItemStatus unconditionally, and @Published does not dedupe, so every activation invalidated everything observing the settings object. Every grid cell observed it just to read animatedPreviewPlaybackMode, so clicking the Dock icon rebuilt all three sections at once. Guard the assignment, pass the mode down as a plain value, and defer the refresh off the activation frame.
Also bound the preview loader: cache the animated flag so the fast path stops rebuilding a CGImageSource on the main thread, size dataMemory to match the image cache so scrolling back does not miss into a full decode, cap in-flight IO, and sample 6 frames instead of 32 when picking a representative one. Preview loading now waits for its section to become active.

Commit: 783485f45562f4455f47fb9a93cd5ac7dc2372f7 Channel: beta
fix(app): forward to the running instance instead of starting a second
A login item launch plus a manual open produced two processes driving the same displays. Post a distributed notification so the existing instance raises its window, then exit.

# Mirage 1.0.3
本版本集中改进壁纸播放控制、创意工坊筛选和 macOS 系统集成，并修复多显示器、屏保和网页壁纸播放的稳定性问题。
## 新增与改进
- 已安装壁纸新增“最近添加”排序，方便快速找到刚下载或导入的壁纸 (#16)。 - 创意工坊新增“最热门（本月）”和“最热门（今年）”趋势范围，并补充分辨率筛选和文本相关性排序 (#10)。 - 设置新增隐藏菜单栏图标选项 (#15)。 - 设置新增 HDR 视频选项，在支持 EDR 的显示器上启用 HDR 视频输出。 - 设置新增“窗口覆盖屏幕超过阈值时暂停”，并改进焦点、全屏、音频、显示器休眠和电池状态下的播放策略。 - 新增开发模式实时日志，自动对 API Key、Token、密码等敏感信息脱敏；登录项在临时签名环境下提供 LaunchAgent 回退，并同步系统状态和错误提示。
## 修复
- 修复网页壁纸在暂停、恢复、切换和激活过程中的音频状态不同步问题。 - 修复视频壁纸及屏保视频的解码和播放流程；转换缓存现在会校验源文件时间，避免使用过期缓存，并保留原始视频文件。 - 修复场景和网页壁纸快照为空或被重复回放时的异常，减少不必要的渲染器资源重建。 - 修复桌面覆盖刷新、多显示器休眠状态和全屏窗口检测，提升自动暂停和恢复的准确性。 - 修复已安装、发现和创意工坊页面之间切换时的视图状态、卡片交互和预览状态稳定性。 - 改进 SteamCMD 下载结果校验及错误提示，并补充相关本地化文本。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本
当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.0.3
This release improves wallpaper playback controls, Workshop discovery, and macOS integration, while stabilizing multi-display, screen saver, and web wallpaper playback.
## Improvements
- Added a **Recently Added** sort order for installed wallpapers, making newly downloaded or imported wallpapers easier to find (#16). - Added **Most Popular (Month)** and **Most Popular (Year)** Workshop trend periods, plus resolution filters and text-relevance sorting (#10). - Added a setting to hide the menu bar icon (#15). - Added an HDR video setting that enables HDR output on EDR-capable displays. - Added **Pause when windows cover more than the threshold**, and improved playback policy handling for focus, fullscreen windows, audio, display sleep, and battery state. - Added live Developer Mode logs with automatic redaction of API keys, tokens, passwords, and similar sensitive values. Login items now fall back to a LaunchAgent for ad-hoc builds and keep system status and error messages synchronized.
## Fixes
- Fixed web wallpaper audio state getting out of sync while pausing, resuming, switching, or activating wallpapers. - Fixed video wallpaper and screen saver decoding/playback; conversion caches now validate the source modification time, avoid stale cached media, and preserve the original video. - Fixed blank or redundantly replayed Scene and Web wallpaper snapshots, reducing unnecessary renderer resource rebuilds. - Fixed desktop-override refresh, multi-display sleep state, and fullscreen-window detection for more accurate automatic pause and resume behavior. - Fixed view state, card interaction, and preview stability when switching between Installed, Discover, and Workshop pages. - Improved SteamCMD download-result validation and error messages, with additional localization coverage.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - Requires macOS 14.2 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
